messages:
evelyn: brain fried after back-to-back calls. need a 15min 'snap back' short film + a 2528min playlist to reset without sending me into full nap mode. cozy but lightly energizing? :woozy_face:
omar: short film: 'La Jete9e' is 28m and surprisingly absorbing. feels like a single breath. not light but very tidy.
talia: if you want lighter: Pixar short 'Piper' is 6min and adorable. pairs well with a brisk 25min playlist.
jess: playlist idea: acoustic opener -> two upbeat instrumentals -> one indie banger -> gentle closer. keeps momentum but no heavy lyrics.
rafael: I made a 26m list last week for a similar meltdown: 1) Explosions in the Sky (10m build) 2) Khruangbin (groove) 3) Feist soft track 4) Olafur Arnalds interlude -> total ~26m. perfect for small chores and breathing breaks.
evelyn: omar, is La Jete9e too intense for 'snap back'? might be heavy.
omar: fair, it's moody. pick 'Piper' if you need cute, 'La Jete9e' if you want to feel weirdly reorganized.
talia: jess, can you paste a quick 25min public playlist? :pray:
jess: sound-bot, can you conjure a 'snap-back' queue? @sound-bot
sound-bot: Playlist created: "snap-back-25"  8 tracks  26m. Includes Explosions in the Sky, Khruangbin, Feist, Olafur Arnalds. Link: https://music.internal/playlists/snap-back-25
evelyn: perfect. going to try Piper + 'snap-back-25' now. will report if I re-emerge soggy or triumphant. snacks for the victor? :cookie:
rafael: cookie bounty noted. also: pro tip  set a 25min timer, do one tiny productive thing, then watch the short. feels ritualistic in a good way.
evelyn: love that. okay timer set. will ping if I resurface victorious (or with muffin crumbs). :raised_hands:
